note: System-wide settings that apply to every game, all the time, without game detection. Each value is a documented Windows setting, backed up before it is written and restored by 'Restore BAKA System Tuning'. No FPS, frame-time, or latency gain is claimed until measured on physical hardware.

devicePolicies.name: HwSchMode
devicePolicies.purpose: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling on supported GPUs and drivers (takes effect after restart)

devicePolicies.name: AllowGameDVR
devicePolicies.purpose: No background game recording for any game

devicePolicies.name: SystemResponsiveness
devicePolicies.purpose: Reserve less CPU for background multimedia tasks (Windows default 20)

devicePolicies.name: SFIO Priority
devicePolicies.purpose: MMCSS Games task storage I/O priority

userPolicies.name: AutoGameModeEnabled
userPolicies.purpose: Windows Game Mode on for every game

userPolicies.name: AllowAutoGameMode
userPolicies.purpose: Windows Game Mode on for every game

userPolicies.name: GameDVR_Enabled
userPolicies.purpose: No background capture while any game runs

userPolicies.name: AppCaptureEnabled
userPolicies.purpose: No background capture while any game runs

userPolicies.name: DirectXUserGlobalSettings
userPolicies.purpose: Windows 'Optimizations for windowed games' (flip-model presentation for DX10/11 windowed and borderless games)

userPolicies.name: MouseSpeed
userPolicies.purpose: Turn off 'Enhance pointer precision' so aim follows raw mouse movement
